name: Operations — Weekly Cycle (7 Days)
description: One-week operational template with standard weekly battle rhythm: Monday kick-off, mid-week review, reporting cycle, and Friday wrap/planning. Suitable for sustained ongoing operations with regular review cadence.

events.title: Mon 0800 — Weekly Kick-Off Brief
events.description: Week begins. Review previous week summary, set objectives for the week, assign tasks.

events.title: Mon 0900 — Task Distribution
events.description: Formal task assignment to Teams A and B for the week.

events.title: Mon 1000 — Intel/Analytics Brief
events.description: Analytics team presents current picture, trend analysis, and priority intelligence.

events.title: Mon 1100 — Stakeholder Update Call
events.description: Weekly stakeholder update. Status, progress against objectives, upcoming events.

events.title: Tue 0900 — Daily Standup (Tuesday)
events.description: Daily standup: what was done, what's planned, any blockers.

events.title: Tue 1400 — Key Deliverable Due
events.description: First weekly deliverable deadline. Replace with specific task.

events.title: Wed 0900 — Daily Standup (Wednesday)
events.description: Mid-week standup: check pace against weekly objectives.

events.title: Wed 1400 — Decision Point
events.description: Mid-week decision review. Adjust priorities, approve/reject changes.

events.title: Thu 0900 — Daily Standup (Thursday)
events.description: Thursday standup. Review completion trajectory for week.

events.title: Thu 1000 — Mid-Week Performance Review
events.description: Analytics presents mid-week performance metrics. Assess against targets.

events.title: Thu 1400 — Risk & Issues Review
events.description: Review open risks and issues. Escalate blockers that need senior decision.

events.title: Fri 0900 — Week Closing Brief
events.description: Friday brief: achievements vs. objectives, carry-forward tasks, next week preview.

events.title: Fri 1100 — Weekly Report Submitted
events.description: Formal weekly operational report submitted to stakeholders.

events.title: Fri 1300 — Lessons Learned Capture
events.description: Brief session to capture lessons learned from the week. Update improvement log.

events.title: Fri 1400 — Next Week Planning
events.description: Begin planning for next week. Draft objectives, initial task list.

events.title: Fri 1600 — Week Closed
events.description: Week formally concluded. Systems in standby, on-call confirmed.
